title: Sculk Soul
description:
Sculk Souler is a plugin that adds one special feature
turns your soul into part sculk
body:
# SCULK SOUL
Sculk souler turns a player into a sculk souler which is a person who was infected by the sculk itself

How it works.



### /sculksoul invite <player> (Operator only)
- this command will send an invite to a person in order for them to become Sculk Souler.
- Its operator only just so people can't turn the entire server into Sculk Soulers. Especially when it is strong when used right
people who will be invited will have an option to Ignore it or write this command
### /sculksoul accept
- players will be able to accept this invitation to become Sculk Souler. Sculk Soulers will be available to use two more commands
### /sculksoul free (Operator only)
- this command will remove a person from being a sculk souler. instead of it being "Kick", I chose free as being a Sculk Souler could be count as an infection.

## Commands available for Sculk Soulers
### /sculksoul heartbeat true/false
- the heartbeat will let player play the warden heartbeat sound effect off of them. its basically just for a show to look cool
### /sculksoul sculkmode true/false
- sculkmode will grand several good effects but also bad side effects which are all part of the theme of sculk being an infection
- Player will gain 2 more hearts (4hp) as long as tehy're in sculkmode
- Player will gain power equal to strength 2 as long as tehy're in sculkmode (note: the buffs are not effects, player still can use strength potion)
- Player will gain speed equal to speed 1 effect
- Player will heal half a heart (1hp) per second when near sculk (20 blocks range)
- Player will heal 2 hearts (4hp) per second when standing on a sculk
### however bad side effects
- Player can no longer heal from anything that would grand "regeneration" effect. Even Golden apples, Totem of undying, Healing potion etc
- Player can no longer heal by having full saturation
- Player will starve more
- If player is not in range of sculk (20 blocks) the player will get timer of 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, the player will start taking damage of 1 heart (2hp) per second. This damage will not show any hit effect, so it can be easily missed.

SculkSoulers are weaker when the fight is moving a lot or when someone is running, but strong when the fight is in one place.
